narrowFactualScope.candidateStatement: The VYLEESI label describes bremelanotide as an agonist of multiple melanocortin receptor subtypes, with MC1R ranked ahead of MC4R in potency. It reports MC4R expression in the central nervous system and links MC1R activation on melanocytes to increased pigmentation. The label leaves the mechanism responsible for improvement in hypoactive sexual desire disorder unknown.

narrowFactualScope.omissionRationale: Per the controlling lead review: this deliberately omits synthetic peptide identity, melanotan-II lineage, therapeutic-dose language, receptor-specific sexual-desire causation and the focal-hyperpigmentation adverse-effect inference. No new clinical-benefit prediction or safety/dosing recommendation is made. Scientific mechanism scope and explicit uncertainty are supported by section 12.1 alone. The original historical statement named both MC4R and MC1R; this candidate does not allege a definitively inverted quantitative potency order, only the label-aligned ranking wording the lead review and final independent assessment found justified.
